units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> <he>אלא ע״י עילא ז׳ וכ׳</he> but, I say, through some accident the goods (in the ship) were upset; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:5:6">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite> <he>גבינתא</he> (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 51a:14">B. Mets. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמתרמי ליה ז׳ כזְבִינְתֵּיה</he> until he strikes upon goods like those he bought.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 51a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>קים ליה בז׳</he> he knew the value of his goods; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="G00042"><he>זְבִינָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:24">Ruth R. to I, 17</cite> (<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 3:4">s. 3</cite>) <he>ואילון ז׳ וכ׳</he> what do these purchases (marketing) mean?
